issues.description: FR3 and FR4 have no dedicated mutants in the mutation testing suite, so their detection strength is unverified by the harness even though the logic appears sound on inspection.
issues.evidence: per_requirement_coverage shows FR3 and FR4 with mutants_targeting: 0, listed under untested_requirements.

recommendations: Consider adding explicit mutation test cases targeting FR3 (invalid gate_name/gate_type) and FR4 (wrong-length or invalid-character recovered_key) to strengthen verifiability of those functional checks.
No security-intent leakage detected in public-facing files (README.md, design_brief.md, metadata.json); dead-bit positions and golden key are kept private as intended.
